candidates.change_summary: Change the block assignment from block.number + 1 to block.number (so guess.block becomes the current block number instead of the next block).
Assign the guess mapping after setting the block number (swap the two assignments), changing the exact ordering of state updates.
Insert an additional guard that requires msg.sender to be a non-zero address, preventing zero-address callers from locking in a guess.
Delete the require that enforces msg.value == 1 ether, allowing calls with other msg.value amounts and changing whether lockInGuess state is set.
Replace transfer of winnings to use call instead of transfer (preserves amount) — changes external behavior when recipient is a contract that may require more gas or revert behavior.
Remove resetting of guesses[msg.sender].block to 0 (so block remains set after settle), changing subsequent observable behavior.
Change block number comparison from '>' to '>=' allowing settle to run when block.number equals stored block, altering when payout can happen.
Compute answer using blockhash of current block.number instead of the stored block, changing the derived answer and payout outcome.
Clear both stored guess and block on settle by setting guess to 0 as well as block, affecting visibility of guess after settle.
